question: As of December 2020, Neiphiu Rio is the Chief Minister of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__.

__
 
• As of December 2020, **Neiphiu Rio** as the **Chief Minister of Nagaland.****​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Neiphiu Rio **is an Indian politician who is the **current Chief Minister of Nagaland.**
 
• Rio has also served as Chief Minister for three separate terms, making him the only Nagaland Chief Minister to have served **three consecutive terms.**
